rationale: No existing spec covers announcement banners. A grep for announcement/banner across tests/ui-testing/playwright-tests/ returns only unrelated usages (VRL warning banners in Dashboards, PNG warning banner in Reports, alert error banner in RegressionSet). The feature is a new global/settings surface (Settings > General authoring drawer + live strip in MainLayout) and belongs in GeneralTests, which already hosts sibling global/settings specs. The new spec must also be appended to the GeneralTests run_files list in .github/workflows/playwright.yml.
